evidence.documentation: Not affected. This is an internal build-system change with no user-facing documentation impact.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This is a build-system internal change with no user-visible behavior or CLI/GUI surface. Not release-critical for manual testing.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The single PR commit (3dd53790630ea852ef5b19b20ca7d7c5557f1280) was the only commit; the merge commit (a5dbbb1e976723d642aa7c57bffd6fd609b719c0) is the squashed result.
evidence.review: PR #3516 was approved by @superm1 (superm1) on 2026-09-09T19:12:29Z. @superm1 is an admin maintainer with subject-matter expertise in linux packaging, system info, ROCm, and security — directly relevant to this CMakeLists.txt build-system change. The PR author self-reviewed the full diff, confirmed it addresses one clear issue, and described concrete local testing.

CI validation is strong — the C++ Server Build, Test, and Release workflow passed across Linux (amd64 and arm64), Windows, and macOS, plus container build tests, smoke tests, and unit tests all succeeded.

subject: Use pkgconfig to find libdrm_amdgpu (#3516)
summary: Switches libdrm_amdgpu detection in CMakeLists.txt from a hardcoded library name to pkgconfig-based discovery, enabling builds on systems with non-standard include and library paths.
verdict_reason: Well-scoped build-system change with adequate review from a maintainer with relevant subject-matter expertise, passing all checks, and no post-approval commits.
